title: Encode and Decode Strings
description: Design an algorithm to encode a list of strings to a string. The encoded string is then sent over the network and is decoded back to the original list of strings.
prompt: Implement functions encode(strs) and decode(s) to encode a list of strings and decode them back.

testCases.description: Encode and decode a simple list of strings

title: Longest Consecutive Sequence
description: Given an unsorted array of integers, find the length of the longest consecutive sequence of elements without sorting.
prompt: Implement function longestConsecutive(nums) returning the length of the longest consecutive sequence.

testCases.description: The longest consecutive sequence is [1, 2, 3, 4] with length 4
The longest consecutive sequence is [0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8] with length 9

title: Valid Palindrome
description: Given a string, determine if it is a palindrome, considering only alphanumeric characters and ignoring cases.
prompt: Implement function isPalindrome(s) returning true if the string is a valid palindrome.

input: A man, a plan, a canal: Panama
testCases.description: After removing non-alphanumeric characters: 'amanaplanacanalpanama' is a palindrome
After cleanup: 'raceacar' is not a palindrome
After cleanup: '0p' is not a palindrome

title: Container With Most Water
description: You are given an integer array height of length n. There are n vertical lines drawn such that the two endpoints of the ith line are (i, 0) and (i, height[i]). Find two lines that together with the x-axis form a container such that the container holds the most water.
prompt: Implement function maxArea(height) returning the maximum area of water that can be contained.

testCases.description: Maximum area between index 1 and 8: min(8,7) * 7 = 49
Maximum area between two lines with height 1

title: Trapping Rain Water
description: Given n non-negative integers representing an elevation map where the width of each bar is 1, compute how much water it can trap after raining.
prompt: Implement function trap(height) returning the total amount of water trapped.

testCases.description: Water trapped in the valleys = 6 units

title: Minimum Window Substring
description: Given two strings s and t, return the minimum window substring of s such that every character in t (including duplicates) is included in the window. If there is no such window, return an empty string.
prompt: Implement function minWindow(s, t) returning the minimum window substring.

testCases.description: The window is the entire string

title: Permutation in String
description: Given two strings s1 and s2, return true if s2 contains a permutation of s1, or false otherwise.
prompt: Implement function checkInclusion(s1, s2) returning true if s2 contains a permutation of s1.

testCases.description: s2 contains the permutation 'ba' at index 1
s2 does not contain any permutation of 'ab'

title: Longest Repeating Character Replacement
description: You are given a string s and an integer k. You can choose any character of the string and change it to any other uppercase English character. You can perform this operation at most k times. Return the length of the longest substring containing the same letter you can get after performing the above operations.
prompt: Implement function characterReplacement(s, k) returning the length of the longest valid substring.

testCases.description: Replace two 'A's with 'B's to get 'BBBB' with length 4
Replace one 'A' to get a substring of length 4

title: Maximum Number of Vowels in a Substring of Given Length
description: Given a string s and a positive integer k, return the maximum number of vowel letters in any substring of s with length k.
prompt: Implement function maxVowels(s, k) returning the maximum number of vowels in a substring of length k.

testCases.description: Any substring of length 2 has 2 vowels

title: Subarray Sum Equals K
description: Given an array of integers nums and an integer k, return the total number of subarrays whose sum equals k. A subarray is a contiguous part of an array.
prompt: Implement function subarraySum(nums, k) returning the count of subarrays with sum equal to k.

testCases.description: Subarrays [1,1] at indices 0-1 and 1-2 sum to 2

title: Valid Parentheses
description: Given a string s containing just the characters '(', ')', '{', '}', '[' and ']', determine if the input string is valid.
prompt: Implement function isValid(s) returning true if parentheses are properly matched and closed.

title: Min Stack
description: Design a stack that supports push, pop, top, and retrieving the minimum element in constant time.
prompt: Implement the MinStack class with push(), pop(), top(), and getMin() methods.

testCases.description: Operations on MinStack returning correct min values

title: Evaluate Reverse Polish Notation
description: Evaluate the value of an arithmetic expression in Reverse Polish Notation. Valid operators are '+', '-', '*', and '/'. Division truncates toward zero.
prompt: Implement function evalRPN(tokens) returning the evaluated result of the RPN expression.

title: Generate Parentheses
description: Given n pairs of parentheses, write a function to generate all combinations of well-formed parentheses.
prompt: Implement function generateParenthesis(n) returning all valid combinations of n pairs of parentheses.

testCases.description: All valid combinations of 3 pairs of parentheses
Only one valid combination for 1 pair
